node.title: F_17^32 row pinned at 506/507
node.statement: The F_17^32 finite row (n=512, k=256) is PINNED: LD_sw(C,506) = 7 (unsafe) and LD_sw(C,507) = 6 (safe), with 6*2^128 < 17^32 < 7*2^128 -- a full adjacent determination on one row (upstream towards-prize.md section 2.1; our smoke_packet replays it). A clean partial-submission result; not the full prize.
